evidence.expiry: 限セクション ヒットなし。格付・分析業はコンセッション/特許満了型の期限独占ではない→no
evidence.erosion: 『Competitive pricing pressures have intensified, which may result in customers' use of free or lower-cost information』『increased competition from non-[NRSRO]』『the introduction or development of competing and/or emerging technologies and products』→競争は顕在化しつつあるが収益は成長継続=emerging
evidence.disrupt: 『pricing pressure from competitors and/or customers』『competing and/or emerging technologies and products』→格付は規制埋込(NRSRO)で需要構造は堅いが、無料情報/新技術の不確実性あり=unsettled(threatとは言えず)
evidence.moatdecay: 『Organic constant currency revenue growth was 8%』(2025)+総収入7.1→7.7十億(+8%)・roicg23.9%>WACC→価格圧力下でも収益と資本収益率を維持=no
evidence.p1: ROICσ=8.9pt(helper・2013-17窓)。窓は陳腐化かつ2016法的和解一過性でσ膨張。MIS格付収入は債券発行量連動で景気敏感→σ8pt級=65。roicg23.9%の水準自体は高位
evidence.p2: COVID2020は営利1998→2388(+20%・借換需要で逆に増加)で耐性。ただし2022発行市場急収縮で営利2844→1883(-34%・中程度DD)=発行サイクル敏感を反映→75
evidence.p3: nde=1.36(<2.5)→70。純負債約4.55十億/EBITDA約3.83十億=1.19。低レバだが純現金ではないため95/85には満たない
evidence.p4: accr=-2.8%(<0・高質)+『ITEM 1B UNRESOLVED STAFF COMMENTS None』。誠hitsのmaterial weaknessは監査手続の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists...』)で実指摘ではない→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC: 2021→25 ΔNOPAT約0.40/ΔIC約0.92十億=約43%、2022→25では約100%。いずれもWACC+15を大幅超・資本集約度低く増分資本僅少→90。ただし2022谷底を基準にすると比率が膨張する点に留意
evidence.f2: TAM浸透の定量hitsなし→保守側65。格付中核は成熟、Moody's Analytics/プライベートクレジットは初期段階。数値不在のため注記
evidence.f3: 『Organic constant currency revenue growth was 8%』=正の一符号 vs 蝕の価格圧力(『pricing pressure intensified』)=負の一符号→片方=75。R&D/売上は当業態で非開示。顧客集中は『no customer accounted for 10% or more』で悪化なし(-10適用せず)
evidence.f4: 『MA...data and data-driven analytical solutions; and ii) risk-management software, workflow and CRE solutions』(Moody's Analytics)=隣接事業が売上5%超で成長→80
evidence.moatW: セグメント別外部売上(FY2025 10-K Note20 Segment Information): MIS 4,119百万$=53.4% / MA 3,599百万$=46.6%、計7,718百万$(社内取引控除後)。MISは発行体課金の信用格付で、NRSRO規制・運用ガイドライン・インデックス組入要件に埋め込まれた需要が源泉。MAは投資家/銀行/保険/事業会社向けのサブスク型データ・分析(Decision Solutions、Research and Insights、Data and Information の3LOB)でARR課金・別顧客・別競合。払い手と課金構造の異なる独立した堀で各≥15%。→ ≥15%の独立した堀は2本 → moatW=85
evidence.dom: 【2026-07-28 dom刻み改定(市場構造織込み)による再判定】自社シェア: Moody's 31.39%(全NRSRO残存格付件数ベース、2024年12月31日時点)。上位2社合計: S&P 49.60% + Moody's 31.39% = 80.99% ≥80%、ただし首位はS&Pで自社は第2位 → 『複占の一角』。上位3社合計: Fitch 12.40% を加えて 93.38%(報告書本文が『The large NRSROs accounted for 93.38% of all the ratings outstanding as of December 31, 2024』と明記) ≥80% → 『3社寡占』。どちらの経路でも刻みは70。自社は圧倒70-89%でも複占の首位でもないため85には該当しない。旧判定は自社31.7%<40%という数字だけの文字適用で50としていたが、上位N社構造を織り込む新刻みでは70。出典: SEC Office of Credit Ratings『2025 Staff Report on NRSROs』Chart 5(2024年12月31日時点、Item 7A on Form NRSRO)および同報告 p.18 本文 https://www.sec.gov/files/2025-ocr-staff-report-compliant-4-24-26.pdf → 自社31.39% / 上位2社80.99%(自社は第2位) / 上位3社93.38% → 刻み70
evidence.irr: irr=85(認証・規格ロック)。10-K Item1 Regulation:『In the U.S., CRAs are subject to extensive regulation primarily pursuant to Section 15E of the Exchange Act and rules thereunder. MIS is registered with the SEC as an NRSRO and is subject to the SEC's oversight and examination authority.』『In the EU ... MIS's EU CRA subsidiaries are registered with ESMA and are subject to its ongoing supervision.』NRSRO登録が規制上の地位＝Item1Aも『increased competition from non-NRSROs that evaluate debt risk』と非NRSROを別枠で扱い、登録の有無が識別子であることを示す。100(唯一供給)にしない理由も原本にあり:『the Reform Act was designed to encourage competition among rating agencies. The formation of additional NRSROs may increase pricing and competitive pressures.』＝登録は認証ロックであって独占供給ではない。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1059556/000162828026009136/mco-20251231.htm
evidence.rep: rep=80(極困難)。10-K Item1A:『Moody's reputation and the strength of its brand are key competitive strengths. To the extent that the credit rating business as a whole or Moody's, relative to its competitors, suffers a loss in credibility, Moody's business will be significantly impacted.』複製には(1)米SEC NRSRO登録(2)EU ESMA登録(3)英FCA(『ratings endorsed into the U.K. are similarly subject to oversight of the FCA』)等の多法域の登録と、格付実績に基づく信認の積み上げが要る。100(複製不能)にしない理由:同10-Kが『The formation of additional NRSROs may increase pricing and competitive pressures』と新規参入の制度的経路を明記し、参入は困難だが不能ではない。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1059556/000162828026009136/mco-20251231.htm
evidence.dur: dur=100(規制型)。10-K Item1 Regulation:『MIS, certain of the Company's credit rating affiliates, and many of the issuers and/or securities that MIS and the affiliates rate, are subject to extensive regulation in the U.S. (including by state and local authorities), EU, U.K. and in other countries.』Item1A:『The current U.S. laws and regulations relating to MIS, including the Reform Act and the Dodd-Frank Act: ... provide the SEC with direct jurisdiction over CRAs that seek NRSRO status, and grant authority to the SEC to inspect the operations of CRAs』。堀の型はネットワーク(85)でもスイッチングコスト(75)でもブランド単独(55)でもなく、NRSRO/ESMA/FCAという規制枠に埋め込まれた事業免許型。出典 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1059556/000162828026009136/mco-20251231.htm
